name: remind-mcp
description: Read Remind classes, chats and messages, and manage notification settings.

tools.name: remind_get_notification_settings
tools.description: Get notification preferences and delivery devices.

tools.name: remind_set_notification_devices
tools.description: Enable or disable notification delivery devices.

tools.name: remind_list_entities
tools.description: List classes and chats with unread counts.

tools.name: remind_get_classes
tools.description: Get full detail for classes by uuid.

tools.name: remind_list_chats
tools.description: List conversation streams and their permissions.

tools.name: remind_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a chat or class (confirm-gated).

tools.name: remind_graphql
tools.description: Run a read-only GraphQL query against Remind.
